import sys

def find_min_k_for_idempotent_function(n, f):
    def is_idempotent(func):
        return all(func[i] == func[func[i]] for i in range(1, n + 1))
    
    current_func = f[:]
    k = 1
    while not is_idempotent(current_func):
        next_func = [current_func[current_func[i]] for i in range(1, n + 1)]
        current_func = next_func
        k += 1
    return k

input = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(input[0])
f = [0] + list(map(int, input[1:]))
print(find_min_k_for_idempotent_function(n, f))
